summary: Tillamook County lookout site: crow's nest 1926, tower 1935-36, replaced 1954, abandoned 1967, removed 1973. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Treated timber live-in tower with a 14x14 cab (1954 tower, replacing the 1936 tower)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1967 and removed in 1973 per the register and Oregon lookouts history (firelookout.com says destroyed); no source describes the site today.
facts.agency: Tillamook FPA (register); Oregon Department of Forestry (Oregon lookouts history)

visit.trail_note: Only route described is from a 1942 inspection: a 3-mile trail from the end of God's Valley Road. No current trail or access information found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1936. A March 1935 Forest Log note, quoted on the Oregon lookouts history, says a primary lookout was established on Rector Mountain then. Both dates are given in the story.
The register and firelookout.com give 41 feet for the 1954 tower; the Oregon lookouts history gives 40 feet. The record's 12.2 m matches 40 feet.
The register and the Oregon lookouts history say removed in 1973. firelookout.com says destroyed in 1973.
The register names the Tillamook FPA. The Oregon lookouts history page is headed Oregon Department of Forestry.

notes_for_editor: Brief height 12.2 m equals 40 ft (Oregon lookouts history); the register and firelookout.com say 41 ft. The first-tower year (1935 vs 1936) is unresolved and both are in the story. firelookout.com's locator '9 miles ENE of Newhalem' looks wrong for Tillamook County (Newhalem is a Washington place name), so it was not used. No source describes the site today; the 1942 trail note is old. Check current site status with the local forestry office before adding visit details.
